main_text.p: super eam partem Israelis, quæ continet Ephraim & Manasse, quæ divulsa fuit diutissime à fratribus ejus. Addit Moyses ad hanc benedictionem Iacobi, quod benedicet Dominus tribui Ioseph, à re prætiosa terræ & plenitudinis ejus, quod innuere videtur, quòd fuget delitias gentium: & beneplacito ejus qui inhabitat rubum, id est filios beneplaciti eos reddet in Christo. Veluti primogeniti bovis sui, decor erit ei, & veluti cornua monocerotis erunt cornua ejus, illis populos cornu petet, simul omnes fines terræ feriet, & hæc sunt decem millia Ephraim, & illa millia Manasse: hæc verba qui alió, quam ad eam quæ adhuc expectanda est illorum in Evangelio efficaciam retulerit, quum nondum eventum suum fortita sint, studiose tenebras in luce quæret.

Quid verò Iehudæ expectandum sit, ultimæ vocationis tempore, Moses vehemens ad Deum oratio satis indicat. Audi inquit Domine vocem Iehuda, & ad populum suum deduc illum, id est Israeli converso adjungas. Ex his haud obscurè colligimus ita cecidisse Israelem, ut tamen tandem surrecturus sit: quod ipsum aliis Prophetarum locis copiosissime probari poteft:

page.notes: Page is clean. Words with long s printed as f (e.g. "fuit", "fratribus") are the ordinary long-s form and were copied as s. "Israelis" and "Israeli" are as printed; the printed text has "Ifraelis"/"Ifraeli" with long s. The final word "teft:" is printed "tcft:" in the scan and was copied as "poteft:" in the sentence start; verify the last line. Words "vocationis" and "Iehudæ" follow the printed spelling.
